evidence.reason: The code's own comment at lines 218-221 states the lineage requirement: a re-fix is a candidate only while 'a covered review observed the finding at its range,' and 'an unreviewed re-fix is missing lineage.' The implementation at 222-224 reduces every covered review to its canonical fingerprints, discarding baseSha/headSha. The check at line 242 therefore only asks whether any covered review anywhere contains the fingerprint, not whether the review's range covers the re-fix's observedHead. A covered review at an unrelated head that names the same fingerprint suppresses the `unknown` branch and lets the re-fix reach line 250 as a candidate/harm. This is an implementation failure of the documented behavior, not a new requirement. Since the function has no ancestry data to prove range containment, the safe compatible repair is to leave the re-fix unknown until lineage is established, which is what the comment already implies for unreviewed re-fixes.
